name: cmos-cloud-bios
title: BIOS // NECROMANCER — 1994 CMOS Utility & 3D Motherboard Cloud Compiler
description: Flagship Website #3: an Award Modular BIOS setup utility that configures real cloud infrastructure. Tune clock multipliers, RAID, IRQ lines and power budgets, watch simulated cost, P99 latency and thermals react on a 3D motherboard twin, then compile docker-compose.yml, vercel.json and main.tf or transmit the config as FSK modem audio.
author: GenUI Studio

remixPresets.label: Inject Corrupted Voltage / Negative IRQ Packet
remixPresets.description: Streams a register packet with negative Vcore and invalid IRQs. The catalog clamps it, the CMOS engine rejects it, and the BIOS loads fail-safe defaults without crashing.
